items.title: AI: Equalizer or Divider?
items.raw_excerpt: There is a saying “God made men, but Samuel Colt made them equal.” AI sometimes can have similar effect. In one enterprise system I’ve seen, the gap between people using a tool 40 hours a week and those using it 2 hours a week nearly disappeared after AI agents were introduced. I have also seen the gap between a 10x developer and an average one shrink after everyone got generous Cursor subscriptions. At the same time, recent public reporting on Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5 and Mythos-class models suggests that the most capable systems may be rolled out through limited-access programs or premium channels rather than broadly and evenly. items.title: 华纳音乐集团收购AI技术公司Sureel
items.raw_excerpt: 华纳音乐集团于6月10日宣布，已达成协议收购人工智能技术公司Sureel AI。此举旨在帮助旗下艺人、词曲作者及其他版权持有者在AI生成内容及AI模型训练中，获得应有的署名与报酬。（新浪财经）

title_i18n.zh: 华纳音乐集团收购AI技术公司Sureel
title_i18n.en: Warner Music Group acquires AI technology company Sureel.

excerpt_i18n.en: Warner Music Group announced on June 10 that it has reached an agreement to acquire AI technology company Sureel AI. This move aims to help its artists, songwriters, and other copyright holders receive proper attribution and compensation in AI-generated content and AI model training. (Sina Finance)
excerpt_i18n.es: El grupo Warner Music Group anunció el 10 de junio que ha llegado a un acuerdo para adquirir la empresa de tecnología de inteligencia artificial Sureel AI. Esta medida tiene como objetivo ayudar a sus artistas, compositores y otros titulares de derechos a obtener el reconocimiento y la compensación adecuados en la generación de contenido mediante IA y el entrenamiento de modelos de IA. (Sina Finance)

excerpt_i18n.en: Apple's 20-billion-parameter AI model now runs on an iPhone by patching in only 1 to 4 billion weights at a time from NAND flash — turning a memory-bandwidth wall into an I/O scheduling problem. WWDC
excerpt_i18n.zh: 苹果200亿参数AI模型现可在iPhone上运行，每次仅从NAND闪存加载10亿至40亿权重，将内存带宽瓶颈转化为I/O调度问题。WWDC
